create_nougat_processor: create a NougatProcessor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for document image processing
run_nougat_processor_call: run the NougatProcessor __call__ method to process document images and tokenize text with cropping and resizing options
run_nougat_processor_with_images: run the NougatProcessor __call__ method with images to crop margins resize and align long axis for document input
run_nougat_processor_with_text: run the NougatProcessor __call__ method with text input to tokenize with padding truncation and max length options
post_process_nougat_generation: post process NougatProcessor generation output by forwarding arguments to the tokenizer post_process_generation method
